visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Stop at the Square Root
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The loop tries every divisor up to n. Stop at the square root and print the leftover prime afterwards. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A composite number always has a factor no bigger than its square root. For a large prime n the old loop ran n times; the new one runs about the square root of n times.
